criteria: Given a customer submits valid payment details, when authorization succeeds, then the system shall mark the payment as Authorized.
Given payment authorization fails, when the gateway returns a failure response, then the order shall not be confirmed.
Given a payment fails, when the failure is confirmed, then the system shall notify the customer.
Given the same payment request is submitted more than once, when the system detects the same transaction reference, then only one payment shall be processed.
Given a failed payment is eligible for retry, when the customer retries payment, then the system shall submit a new authorization attempt.
Given payment authorization succeeds, when the transaction is confirmed, then the system shall create the customer order.
Given an authorized support user searches for a transaction, when the transaction exists, then the latest payment status shall be displayed.
Given a transaction is eligible for refund, when an authorized user submits a full refund, then the system shall initiate the refund for the full eligible amount.
Given a transaction supports partial refunds, when an authorized user enters a valid partial amount, then the system shall process that partial refund.
Given a transaction is classified as high risk, when payment processing begins, then fraud validation shall complete before payment confirmation.
Given a customer payment fails, when the payment gateway returns a failure status, then a customer notification shall be triggered.
Given a payment failure notification is generated, then the message shall include the transaction status and a customer-friendly failure message.
Given an authorized business user provides a valid transaction identifier, when a search is submitted, then matching transaction details shall be displayed.
